en.joke: The algorithm knows I'm sad before I do.
en.explanation: This joke is funny because it's a relatable, deadpan observation on how eerily accurate social media algorithms are at predicting our emotional states through our digital behavior.

zh.joke: 每次我下定决心要高效工作时，手机就会自动识别到这种紧张气氛，然后立马给我推送一堆轻松愉快的短视频，美其名曰“放松辅助”。

people.name: Saumyendranath Tagore
people.extract: Saumyendranath Tagore, son of Sudhindranath Tagore, fourth child of Dwijendranath Tagore, and grandnephew of Rabindranath Tagore, was the leader of the Revolutionary Communist Party of India, and the first translator of The Communist Manifesto into Bengali, which was published in Langal magazine edited by Kazi Nazrul Islam.
highlights: Leader of the Revolutionary Communist Party of India.
First translator of The Communist Manifesto into Bengali.

people.name: Ernst Kretschmer
people.extract: Ernst Kretschmer was a German psychiatrist who researched the human constitution and established a typology.

people.name: Rona Barrett
people.bio: American gossip columnist, book writer, businesswoman, and philanthropist (born 1936)
people.extract: Rona Barrett is a retired American television news correspondent, interviewer, gossip columnist and businesswoman. She runs the Rona Barrett Foundation, a non-profit organization in Santa Ynez, California, dedicated to the aid and support of senior citizens in need.
highlights: Foundation aids senior citizens in need.
